question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` and its predicate become a supported public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract?
rationale: The repair adds durable third-party API surface; whether external plugins should produce or consume generic progress intent requires maintainer ownership beyond correcting the Slack branch defect.

options.title: Approve the narrow public contract
options.body: Keep the generic marker and predicate with complete Slack route coverage, SDK contract checks, and exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep the marker internal
options.body: Move progress intent through a bundled/internal seam and avoid expanding the third-party Plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic marker and predicate with complete Slack route coverage, SDK contract checks, and exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work owns both the Slack reply planner and the existing progress marker being generalized.
